headline: HuyenBao v11.58 — items extracted to JSON + LLM-powered item generator
summary: DATA SEPARATION + LLM INTEGRATION. All 67 ITEMS + 12 RARE_ITEMS + 12 USED_MARKET entries extracted from gameData.ts into public/items.json (single source of truth). New API route /api/items/generate calls a local LLM server (LLAMA_SERVER_URL=http://172.31.144.1:8888) to generate random new items with LLM-generated brand/name/backstory + random color/rarity/price/condition. After generation, the route searches the web for a matching image (z-ai-web-dev-sdk image search → picsum.photos fallback) and attaches the URL. A '✨ Generate new item' button in AssetsTab calls the API, registers the item into the live pool via registerItem(), and opens its category so the player sees it land. Falls back to deterministic generation when LLM is offline — no crash path.
features: NEW: public/items.json — all 67 items + 12 rare items + 12 used market listings extracted from gameData.ts
NEW: gameData.ts loads items from JSON import (synchronous, module-load safe) + loadItems() for client-side runtime fetch + registerItem() to add LLM-generated items to the live pool
NEW: /api/items/generate route — calls LLAMA_SERVER_URL (default http://172.31.144.1:8888) with OpenAI-compatible chat completions API
NEW: LLM generates brand + name + color + backstory; route computes category + rarity + price + luxury + rate + condition + art icon
NEW: image search via z-ai-web-dev-sdk (real CDN URLs) → picsum.photos fallback → always returns a usable image URL
NEW: graceful degradation — if LLM offline/unreachable/malformed, falls back to deterministic random generator (no crash)
NEW: registerItem(item) merges generated items into ITEMS + ITEM_BY so they're immediately buyable in the catalogue
NEW: '✨ Generate new item' button in AssetsTab — calls API, registers item, toasts result, opens category
NEW: asset() URL-aware so external image URLs render correctly even with NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_PATH
